The UV disinfection system has been incorporated into a dual barrier disinfection system which includes application of chlorine as free chlorine at a very low dosage upstream of the UV disinfection to inactivate any virus that is not readily susceptible to UV, followed by UV disinfection to inactivate any other pathogens.
a minimal amount of chlorine is added to the UV-disinfected effluent to provide minimal residual chlorine to reclaimed water supplied for direct reuse

Treated wastewater that is not conveyed to direct reuse is dechlorinated prior to discharge in order to remove any chlorine residual. Treated wastewater discharged to San Gabriel River and Rio Hondo is dechlorinated.
Sewage solids separated from the wastewater are returned to the trunk sewer for conveyance to JWPCP for treatment and disposal and are regulated by Order Number R4-2017-0180.
